title: T12 paper_v2 archive ID columns declared UUID but source IDs are prefixed TEXT
description: T12 DDL declares several archive columns as UUID, but the live paper_v2 source uses prefixed TEXT IDs such as paper_<hex>, prun_<hex>, ord_<hex>, evt_<hex>, fill_<hex>, rprof_<hex>, rcact_<hex>, epact_<hex>, pkg_<hex>, session_<hex>. Mirroring real paper_v2 rows would fail with 'invalid input syntax for type uuid'. Round-2 audit revealed 16 UUID columns total (Codex brief named only 5). All converted to TEXT to accept prefixed source IDs - archive directly mirrors source per dw-foundation policy decision (no transform layer). P1.3 of Codex T12+T14a review.
